assets.purpose: Explain four-chromatid starting structure, a nonsister crossover and the two recombinant products.
assets.placement: The image below follows one crossover between the A and B loci.
assets.viewing: Find blue/red copied homologues, distinguish two sisters in each, follow the two inner nonsisters and the lower segment that changes colour.
assets.labels: Prophase I; tetrad; nonsister chromatids; pachytene; chiasma; metaphase I; metaphase II; daughter cells; parental types; recombinants; AB, Ab, aB, ab.
assets.semantics: Blue/red trace homologue origin, not dominance. Downward arrows summarise meiotic progression; branch to two cells follows homologue separation; final four cells follow chromatid separation.
assets.constraints: One pictured crossover affects two of four chromatids. No second replication; no claim every meiosis or gamete is recombinant. Figure is a simplified stage schematic.
assets.caption: One illustrated crossover between the tracked loci changes two of the four chromatids. Blue and red trace chromosome origins, not dominance.

assets.purpose: Establish relative interval length before assigning map units.
assets.placement: The chromosome drawing below makes the interval idea visible before we assign a unit.
assets.viewing: Match the upper blue B/b, lower purple H/h and nearby green d/D loci across homologues; compare H/d gap with B/H gap.
assets.labels: B,H,d on left; b,h,D on right. Corresponding aligned loci.
assets.semantics: Coloured bands identify three loci. Outlined callouts connect labels to corresponding bands. Curved black outlines represent homologous chromosomes; no scale or exchange event is drawn.
assets.constraints: Do not infer numeric cM, chromosome identity, physical DNA length or uniform recombination rate from pixel lengths.
assets.caption: Compare intervals on one homologue, then match corresponding loci on the other. The colours identify loci; the drawing gives no numerical scale.
